issues.jp_before: テストの結果[けっか]が悪[わる]くて、妹[いもうと]は今[いま]にも{泣[な]きそうです|pt-sou-look}。
issues.problem: English opened with 'Her' before its antecedent (awkward translation).
issues.action: English rewritten: 'My little sister got a bad test result and looks about to cry.'

issues.jp_before: 点[てん]が離[はな]されて、この試合[しあい]は{負[ま]けそうです|pt-sou-look}。
issues.problem: 点が離されて is unnatural Japanese for 'we are far behind on points'.
issues.action: Context rewritten to 点差[てんさ]が大[おお]きくて; slot, distractors and English unchanged.

issues.jp_before: 風邪[かぜ]をひいたのか、娘[むすめ]は{つらそうに|pt-sou-look}せきをしています。
issues.problem: English put 'She' before 'my daughter' and did not render 〜のか well.
issues.action: English rewritten: 'My daughter may have caught a cold; she is coughing and looks as if it hurts.'

issues.jp_before: 兄[あに]の電話[でんわ]によると、今日[きょう]は帰[かえ]りが{遅[おそ]くなるそうです|pt-sou-hear}。
issues.problem: 兄の電話によると is unnatural. The distractor 遅くなったそうです is acceptable for a return home that has now been settled as late, so it is not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Sentence rewritten to 兄[あに]から電話[でんわ]があって、…; distractor replaced with 遅[おそ]くなりたいです; English updated.

issues.jp_before: 父[ちち]の話[はなし]では、おじいさんは若[わか]いころ、船[ふね]の{船長[せんちょう]だったそうです|pt-sou-hear}。
issues.problem: おじいさん is the wrong word for one's own grandfather when talking to others.

issues.jp_before: テレビによると、今年[ことし]の冬[ふゆ]は例年[れいねん]より{寒[さむ]いそうです|pt-sou-hear}。
issues.problem: 例年 is N2-level vocabulary in an N4 item (lv 4).
issues.action: Replaced with 去年[きょねん]; English changed to 'colder than last year'.
